name: document-converter-plugin-deps
description: Vendored runtime dependencies for the document-converter plugin — see tools/convert-document.js. Committed node_modules, not gitignored: the plugin installer copies this directory verbatim with no npm-install step, so the resolved dependency tree must already exist on disk for Node's module resolution to find it (same pattern as plugins/image-converter/package.json). mammoth converts docx to html; marked/turndown convert md<->html. PDF output uses no library here — it goes through ctx.renderHtmlToPdf, which Filer renders with the operating system's own browser engine (headless Microsoft Edge on Windows); where no renderer exists the call rejects and the conversion reports it.
